# Phosphor Icons

Source: https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core/tree/2b75f3ad12b420c9504ef05df8d2564a28f8500e

Only the 14 Regular and 4 Fill icons used by PengWa are bundled as Android Vector Drawables in `core/designsystem/src/main/res/drawable/ph_*.xml`. Original 256 × 256 path geometry is preserved. MIT license: [phosphor-LICENSE.txt](phosphor-LICENSE.txt).

The same license is packaged in the APK at `assets/licenses/phosphor-LICENSE.txt`.

# Simple Icons

Six social platform icons (QQ, WeChat, bilibili, Xiaohongshu, X, Telegram) are bundled offline as Android Vector Drawables in `res/drawable/social_*.xml`.
Source: https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/90646e4bf7f3b89df6c37e65baf3e7bc759a517c/icons

Original 24 × 24 path geometry is preserved. CC0 1.0 Universal: [simple-icons-LICENSE.md](simple-icons-LICENSE.md).
The same license is packaged in the APK at `assets/licenses/simple-icons-LICENSE.md`.

# Nordic Android BLE Library

BLE GATT client transport uses https://github.com/nordicsemi/Android-BLE-Library (BSD-3-Clause). The original license is bundled at `app/src/main/assets/licenses/nordic-ble-LICENSE.txt`. Scanning, advertising and the existing peripheral implementation remain native.
